This started out as a comment, but by the end, I realized I had created OC, so I'm giving it its own post. It's not directly MRM related, but it does concern fundamental understanding of the nature of biological sex and its consequences, which is an important thing to get right if you're going to quality discussions in this area.

Ok, so Laci Green is fucking horrible, but this response video, which is currently making some tentative moves toward the frontpage, definitely, 100% oversteps.

We here in the MRM are pretty big on the idea that biology is not, in fact, a patriarchal construct. Gay people are born that way, yes, and straight people are too, and this will have social consequences, even ones we don't like. The problem isn't that men commit suicide more than women--they always have and always will--it's that nobody knows and nobody cares. A Men's Rights victory would be nudging boys down to a mere 70% of adolescent suicides, rather than the 86% or so they currently are. We shouldn't ignore it, and we shouldn't take it for granted, but biology seems to dictate that we'll never get to 50-50. That's unfortunate. So are a lot of "issues" feminists like to whine about. As long as women's bodies are the only things capable of creating sentient life, women's bodies are going to be a big deal in every society on the planet.

Life is complicated, and in Laci's video, she says that human brains categorize things in a lazy fashion that tends to oversimplify things. And they totally do. Where she goes off the rails is in suggesting that intersex people are remotely common or normal. (Not that intersexes should be treated as freaks, but many of them are sterile. I'm not about to insult them by pretending they bear no burden.) So common and normal, in fact, that they constitute a biological continuum between male and female. Horseshit. Biology absolutely tends to sort things into male and female, and there are social and behavioral consequences from that sorting. There is a species of beetle in which the male produces a huge wad of beetle-jizz (zing) that fertilizes the eggs, yes, but also dries into a huge jizz-ball. After the eggs hatch, the larvae eat the jizz-ball, which sustains them the way a yolk sac would a developing vertebrate. In this species, because the males must invest more biological resources in the offspring, females compete sexually for males. Presumably, in this species, females also die alone and poor more, commit suicide more, are a larger portion of the homeless beetle population, and an outsized portion of the Chief Executive Beetle population, but of course, none of this should be taken for granted or ignored by beetlekind.

Every human fetus starts off female. That's the default setting. Shit has to happen to it to make it become male. Sometimes different shit happens and you get a gay dude, and there are a few theories about why this happens, but it does happen enough that it seems to be a "normal" minority in a Darwinistic scheme. Interestingly, there is more compelling science for gay men to be "born this way" than for gay women. Now a large part of this is because there are so few lesbians that doing solid science on them is difficult, but if you want to look further into this, look up why feminists hate Dan Savage. At any rate, sometimes other shit happens, and the plumbing doesn't match the wiring at all, and you get a transgender person. (Most important thing to know is that if you have a kid who says they're trans, there are drugs they can take which delay puberty so that any irrevocable decisions can be made by a 16 year old rather than a 12 year old.) And sometimes, even more complicated shit happens in that process, and you get an intersex person.

Where the response video fucks up unforgivably is in asserting that there are no intersex people. Rather than wade into arguments about chromosomes, let's talk about a couple of conditions that neither party really addressed: Androgen Insensitivity Syndrome, and 5-alpha-reductase deficiency.

In AIS, a person with XY chromosomes has testicles, which produce androgens (a catch-all term for male hormones, there is no hormone called "androgen"), but the cells lack receptors for the testosterone, et c. Because human fetuses default to female, these people have breasts and vaginas, but no uterus, and undescended testicles instead of ovaries. (Generally. There are different types of AIS.) I don't know how you can call a person so equipped anything other than a special case.

People with 5-alpha-reductase deficiency have female-looking genitalia when born, but basically grow penises at puberty. (Another generalization, but I linked the article if you want more detail.) Again, I don't see how you can classify this as anything other than a special case.

If you're still not convinced, well then there's always true hermaphrodites, whose internal sex organs have both ovarian and testicular tissue. Anybody still think intersexes don't exist?

The point is that these people are incredibly rare, but they're still people, and they are still "born this way". If you have a child and you're not sure what's up, I recommend doing nothing in infancy. As intactivists, we MRAs should find the notion of consent an easy sell. And, if you're not conversant with the story of David Reimer, you probably should be, since it highlights the consequences of trying to fuck around with biology in the name of "social constructs". Whatever unique thing your intersex kid is, be assured they are born that way, and they will have a difficult life. Do your best.

That said, the existence of these rare individuals does not mean that social manifestations of typical Darwinian sexuality (and I would include gay pride parades in these) are "oppressive" any more than foods containing phenylalinine are "microaggressions" against phenylketonurics. Yeah, the holidays are probably gonna be a little less merry if you find eggnog to be absolutely fucking lethal, but that doesn't make the people swilling it in front of you "shitlords", and it doesn't make eggnog a discriminatory, backwards tradition warranting a boycott.

Indeed, I would argue that people who are special cases will probably have an easier time of it if the societal context they find themselves in is less fucked up. Having your genitals become decidedly more masculinized at age twelve is going to be less traumatizing if it isn't so shitty to be male to begin with, e.g. if your society has a 70% adolescent male suicide rate instead of an 86% one. Similarly, a baby with ambiguous genitalia will have a much better chance of figuring shit out for themselves if the intactivist side of the MRM has already succeeded in promoting the ideas of consent and the natural right of bodily integrity.

Anyway, sorry if this is a bit afield, but this is a topic we should get right, for many reasons.

Sleep is different to hibernation. Hibernation the operating image is saved to the hard disk and sleep it's stored in memory. Your computer should still go to sleep when you close the lid.

In Linux Mint however, unfortunately both "hibernate" and "suspend" are enabled by default. To be on the safe side, I advise to disable "hibernate" in Linux Mint in all cases.
